mechanism: Carvedilol (beta-blocker with alpha-blocking properties) and haloperidol (antipsychotic with alpha-blocking and cardiac effects) combine to increase risk of hypotension, syncope, and QT prolongation through additive cardiovascular depression and alpha-receptor blockade.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess QT interval baseline and periodically, consider alternative antipsychotic with lower cardiac risk, and adjust carvedilol dose if significant hypotension develops.
